content: Official Godot archive and NuGet confirm stable Godot .NET and Godot.NET.Sdk 4.7.2 released 2026-08-18. Microsoft download confirms SDK 10.0.404, runtime10.0.15, CSharp14 on 2026-11-10. Godot4.7 CSharp basics still discusses net8 minimum; exact net10 editor plus exports and inherited analyzer combination requires Phase1 proof. Sources https://godotengine.org/download/archive/ https://www.nuget.org/packages/Godot.NET.Sdk/4.7.2 https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/10.0
